# Runtime set the installers put in .venv with `pip install --require-hashes --only-binary :all:`:
# every requirement below, transitive ones included, is pinned to an exact version and to the sha256
# of every file PyPI publishes for it, so a wheel whose hash is not listed is refused. Wheels only:
# the sdist hashes stay in the list but the installers never build one (pip does not hash-check the
# build tools an sdist pulls in), so a platform without a wheel fails instead of building. The wheels
# cover Linux, macOS and Windows on Python 3.11 to 3.14. The lines with `implementation_name !=
# 'cpython'` are PyPy-only dependencies, kept so the hashed install also resolves there.
# certifi 2026.10.19 drops the distrusted emSign ECC Root CA - G3 (GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2).
#
# Update as a reviewed set, never by hand: edit requirements.in (top-level pins), regenerate as
# CONTRIBUTING.md says (uv drops this header; the recipe keeps it) and rerun the installers and
# provider smoke tests.

#    uv pip compile --universal --generate-hashes --python-version 3.11 requirements.in -o requirements.txt
